description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various models or configurations. The horizontal axis represents the different categories; it lacks an explicit axis label and individual tick labels beneath the bars, relying instead on a legend positioned to the right of the chart to identify each category by color. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from just below 40% to 65%, featuring numeric tick labels at regular 5% intervals (40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%, and 65%) accompanied by horizontal dashed gridlines. The chart displays six individual bars, each outlined in black, arranged side-by-side from left to right without any specific sorting by height. The first bar is light grey, labeled "RoBERTa w/o Exp." in the legend, and represents the lowest accuracy at approximately 46.5%. The second bar is light blue, corresponding to an entry in the legend that lacks a text label but displays a small grey rectangle, and reaches about 55%. The third bar is orange, labeled "LaSQuE (mean)", with a value of roughly 47%. The fourth bar is green, labeled "LaSQuE", and also sits at approximately 47%. The fifth bar is purple, labeled "LaSQuE (syn2real)", and extends to about 58.5%. The sixth bar is dark grey, labeled "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)", and is the tallest bar in the chart with an accuracy of approximately 62%.
